results: At any actual native resolvent energy, the ENTIRE native H1-to-full-dual pencil is realized as a Banach isomorphism. Its inverse and base resolvent are identified EXACTLY with the previously constructed actual native inverses. Both the native positive pencil and the A-lambda*J normalization have the same root spaces; the nonzero sign is accounted for explicitly.

EVERY finite native root-chain level and the FULL algebraic root space are identified exactly with the corresponding nonzero generalized eigenspace of an ACTUAL compact base resolvent. For EVERY original complex ambient H-minus-one potential and EVERY complex energy, including zero, the full actual native algebraic root space is FINITE DIMENSIONAL and is attained at a finite chain length. The entire increasing sequence stabilizes.

Actual finite native algebraic multiplicity is now defined from that verified full root space for all original complex potentials. It is positive exactly on the FULL native spectrum and zero exactly on the FULL resolvent. For every original complex unit-period source it is positive exactly at the independently normalized characteristic zeros. This proves its support, not equality of its numerical value with analytic zero order.

The full unit-period forced residual is constructed BEFORE restricting tests, with forcing given by the ACTUAL preceding native H1 vector through its unchanged mass form. The full restriction equals the entire actual inhomogeneous native equation. Every signed original Fourier mode reads exactly the original residual minus the forcing coefficient.

An actual native inhomogeneous equation is equivalent to its FULL residual being one scalar multiple of the endpoint trace. For every complex L2 Miura profile, it implies the complete weak first-order coefficient equation with BOTH the forcing term and the central boundary defect. Conversely, that coefficient equation, at every mode with one defect scalar, implies the ENTIRE original zero-trace H1 weak equation.

Every native inhomogeneous Miura equation with preceding native H1 vector recovers a continuous, absolutely continuous, FULL interval H1 quasi-derivative. Its second physical row includes exactly the preceding scalar position. Its actual endpoint jump equals the computed central forced residual. No periodicity of the quasi-derivative or matching endpoint values is imposed.

Conversely, the actual forced physical first-order rows, with their original interval regularity, imply the FULL native inhomogeneous equation. Fourier integration by parts retains the endpoint jump. Thus these physical rows characterize every associated-vector equation in both directions, not only eigenvectors.

Simultaneous constant translation of original potential and energy cancels in every native inhomogeneous equation WITHOUT changing its forcing vector. The verified actual shifted Miura chart therefore gives the exact physical forced-row criterion for EVERY original COMPLEX unit-period H-minus-one potential and EVERY complex energy, including zero and the whole central region.

All finite native coefficient-chain spaces are constructed with the ENTIRE zero-trace H1 domain at every coefficient. Evaluation of the final included vector is a linear equivalence with the ACTUAL partial-operator root-space level. Every such chain space is finite dimensional at every complex potential, and its eventual dimension is EXACTLY the actual full native algebraic multiplicity.

Appending a native chain coefficient is exactly the actual inhomogeneous equation with its preceding native coefficient. For EVERY complex source, this is also exactly the forced physical row criterion in the chosen actual Miura chart. The zero-length endpoint convention retains the eigenvector equation at the first coefficient.

Every native chain polynomial is analytic in the full H1 norm and solves the actual affine spectral pencil up to EXACTLY its final Nth-power included domain vector. Every retained native residual derivative below N vanishes. Conversely, vanishing of ALL those retained derivatives for an arbitrary native polynomial implies its coefficients form the ACTUAL full-domain chain. This is an exact native residual jet criterion; scalar characteristic jets are not substituted for the residual.

The article REAL source adapters now express characteristic orders, multiplicity one of every full original label and the entire label-count identity using the ACTUAL finite operator algebraic multiplicity defined for all complex potentials. They retain the full original distribution and all central labels. Numerical COMPLEX algebraic-order matching is not inferred from the real identities.
